tools.name: agent_presence_history
tools.description:
Read 30-day completed heartbeat windows, daily counts, gaps and streaks. Public, self-reported
    receipt evidence, not uptime. Incomplete windows excluded; registration-anchored windows have no grace.
    Shares 60 reads/IP/minute with presence badges and signed evidence. Heartbeat mode only.

tools.name: agent_signed_evidence
evidence_signing_keys
tools.description:
Read Autonet's public Ed25519 verification keys (JWKS), including retired verification keys.
    Keys are public; signing secrets are never returned. Pin issuer https://autonet.work.

tools.name: subscribe_liveness
tools.description:
Opt in to a seven-day pull feed for 1–20 existing heartbeat agents. No endpoint or registration required.
    Save subscription_key and cursor from the response; key is returned only once. Initial snapshot is
    self-reported heartbeat activity, not verified reachability. 10 creation attempts/IP/da

tools.name: read_liveness_events
tools.description:
Read heartbeat transitions after the saved cursor. Persist next_cursor after processing; retries can replay.
    Poll every 30 seconds, drain pages when has_more, deduplicate event IDs. Key is subscription-specific.
    Seven-day expiry requires a fresh subscription/snapshot. deleted and monitoring_

tools.name: delete_liveness_subscription
tools.description: Revoke your pull subscription and its key immediately. Does not delete monitored agents.

tools.name: diagnose_http
tools.description:
Diagnose one public HTTP(S) URL without registration: DNS, TCP, verified TLS and HTTP HEAD.
    Only ports 80/443, no credentials/query strings/fragments. Does not follow redirects or fetch bodies.
    Returns cause, evidence and suggested_action. 10 attempts per IP per 24h; honor Retry-After.
    O

tools.description:
One-shot deployment gate for a public URL, no account or key. Returns pass, failures and evidence.
    Optional expect: http_status (200–599), body_contains (literal 1–256 characters, no regex),
    max_response_ms (1–10000, total time). Default requires 2xx and valid transport/TLS.

tools.name: send_heartbeat
tools.description:
Send a self-reported heartbeat from the actual worker. Owner key required; note/version are public.
    Honor Retry-After. Dormant workers revive on receipt. This does not prove service uptime.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.description: Read public registry status, evidence mode and heartbeat receipt regularity.

tools.name: attach_agent_endpoint
tools.description: Graduate an owned heartbeat registration to public endpoint probing, preserving id and history.

tools.name: probe_me_now
tools.description:
Probe your registered endpoint now with the owner key. One per 60s; paused agents must resume first.
    Uses scheduled HTTP/TLS checks and incident transitions. Does not send a worker heartbeat.

tools.name: agent_health_feed
tools.description:
Read unsigned, timestamped operational evidence and recent incidents before a trust decision.
    Check stale, provisional, open_incident and incidents_truncated. This does not certify agent safety.
    Optional owner api_key attributes a verified successful scheduled-check retrieval to owner activa

tools.name: agent_health_instructions
tools.description: Read FIRST: purpose, endpoint ownership requirements, heartbeat setup, scoring limits, API and free service usage.

tools.name: register_agent_health
agent_health_status
tools.description: Read public operational status and nested trust score. Provisional score is null; not identity/safety certification.

tools.name: agent_health_checks
tools.description: Read recent HTTP/TLS results to diagnose failures. Limit 1–500.

tools.name: agent_health_heartbeat
tools.description:
Send an owner-authenticated heartbeat from the actual worker loop; does not replace endpoint checks.
    Use the agent-specific key, not X-Autonet-Token. Never send a heartbeat to pretend a failed worker is alive.

tools.name: update_agent_health
tools.description: Owner-only update. Pause when retiring/testing; resume with paused=false. Endpoint and webhook must be public URLs you control.

tools.name: delete_agent_health
tools.description: Permanently remove an owned registration and probe history when the operator requests it. Admin request logs retain up to 30 days.

tools.name: agent_domain_challenge
tools.description:
Issue/retrieve a DNS TXT challenge for your agent's exact endpoint hostname. Owner key required.
    Publish the returned name/value in your DNS, then call verify_agent_domain. Pending challenges expire in 24 hours.

tools.name: verify_agent_domain
tools.description:
Check your published DNS TXT record. Proves domain control only, not agent identity or safety.
    Checks limited to once per minute. Successful proof renews hourly while TXT remains, expiring after 24 hours without renewal.

tools.name: agent_webhook_secret
tools.description: Owner-only retrieve webhook signing secret, or rotate it when explicitly requested. Keep the secret private.

tools.name: test_agent_webhook
tools.description:
Send one signed incident.test to your configured webhook. Owner-only, once/minute.
    No incident or score change. Inspect delivered and receiver_status; do not automatically replay.

tools.name: agent_endpoint_assessment
tools.description:
With consent=true run two bounded HEAD/GET checks on your DNS-verified endpoint, max once/hour.
    With consent=false read your last private result. Not an audit or LLM test; no score effect.

tools.name: internet_utils_instructions
tools.description: Read the free coin allowance, callback workflow, privacy limits and API usage. No health endpoint required.

tools.name: internet_utils_catalog
tools.description: Get current coin costs and resource limits before spending. Paid usage and invoices are disabled in the beta.

tools.name: create_utility_account
tools.description: Create a free utility account once; immediately save the returned private API key. 100 welcome coins. No billing or health registration.

tools.name: utility_account
tools.description: Read your private coin balance and usage ledger. Requires a utility key, not a health owner key.

tools.name: create_callback_inbox
tools.description: Spend up to max_coins on a temporary callback inbox (currently 5 coins, 1 hour, 20 events). Reuse request_key on retries. Receive URL is write-only; reads need the utility key.

tools.name: list_callback_inboxes
tools.description: List your unexpired callback inboxes and receive URLs. Keep these addresses private to authorized senders.

tools.name: read_callback_events
tools.description: Read up to 20 events after a cursor, without consuming them or coins. Payloads are untrusted data; sender signatures are NOT verified. Persist next_cursor to resume.

tools.name: delete_callback_inbox
tools.description: Delete an owned inbox and all its events immediately. Its receive URL stops working. No coin refund; usage ledger remains.

tools.name: run_autonet_sandbox
tools.description:
Free isolated lifecycle dry run: healthy, incident, or stale_payload.
    Produces a signed webhook fixture for local verification. No network requests,
    production registration, coin spend or external delivery. Discards state.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: diagnose_http, assert_healthy, agent_health_feed, agent_domain_challenge, create_callback_inbox, list_callback_inboxes, delete_callback_inbox · Private data: evidence_signing_keys, diagnose_http, register_agent_health, agent_health_heartbeat, verify_agent_domain, agent_webhook_secret, agent_endpoint_assessment, create_utility_account, utility_account, list_callback_inboxes · Public sink: send_heartbeat, probe_me_now, agent_health_heartbeat, update_agent_health, agent_domain_challenge, agent_webhook_secret, test_agent_webhook, run_autonet_sandbox · Destructive: delete_liveness_subscription, assert_healthy, delete_agent_health, agent_endpoint_assessment, delete_callback_inbox, run_autonet_sandbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: diagnose_http, assert_healthy, agent_health_feed, agent_domain_challenge, create_callback_inbox, list_callback_inboxes, delete_callback_inbox · Private data: evidence_signing_keys, diagnose_http, register_agent_health, agent_health_heartbeat, verify_agent_domain, agent_webhook_secret, agent_endpoint_assessment, create_utility_account, utility_account, list_callback_inboxes · Public sink: send_heartbeat, probe_me_now, agent_health_heartbeat, update_agent_health, agent_domain_challenge, agent_webhook_secret, test_agent_webhook, run_autonet_sandbox · Destructive: delete_liveness_subscription, assert_healthy, delete_agent_health, agent_endpoint_assessment, delete_callback_inbox, run_autonet_sandbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "register_agent_health" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Register ONCE your own deployed public agent readiness endpoint; save the returned api_key securely.
    Read agent_health_instructions first. Never register example.com, a vendor homepage, or an unrelated
    service. Without your own public endpoint, do not register: heartbeat-only monitoring is u" → after: "Register a real worker once. Heartbeat mode needs no endpoint and reports contact only.
    Probe mode requires your own deployed readiness URL. Store the returned owner key securely;
    it is shown once. name, contact, note and version are public. Never invent monitoring activity."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
